---
title: Release checklist
---

1. Run `bash scripts/lock.sh` and `uv run --frozen pytest -q --cov=pymc_cache --cov-fail-under=85`.
2. Run `uv run --frozen ruff check src tests scripts examples` and `bash scripts/build-docs.sh`.
3. Validate PyMC 5.28/ArviZ 0.x and PyMC 6/ArviZ 1.x on the supported Python matrix in CI.
4. Build with `uv build --no-sources`; run `python scripts/check_artifact.py` for archive scope and isolated wheel/sdist smoke tests.
5. Inspect `dist/` and changelog, then tag a reviewed commit. PyPI publishing remains a separate manual tag-gated action. Docs build on PRs; GitHub Pages deploys from main only.

Never upload test results or real posterior data. Do not remove old external cache directories during migration.
